sources.title: Chelsea Market reviews | Exa place listing
sources.text: Awesome place to visit, kids loved it, nice food and veggie/vegan options, about 3 hours with a solid break for some dinner. They had a Chinese new year event that was simple but nice for the children. Lots of little indie shops with really interesting items and few other gift types shops. Must visit after doing the high line (if you ended at 10th side exit). It's a great place with a wonderful atmosphere where you can find a wide variety of delicious dishes. We had oysters and really liked them. This was our 1st time visiting Chelsea Market and Wow is all I can say. This place left us speechless. First of all the building is beautiful, then all the restaurant and shops are just amazing. This is such a unique place and we will definitely be back to explore more spots. • Really glad I finally got to visit Chelsea Market! • Such a great variety of food and shopping stalls—you really can’t go wrong with any of them. My favorites were the fresh noodle spot and Seed + Mill for dessert. • We also loved the artist flea market area—so many amazing finds! Picked up some souvenirs and bath + skincare goodies from IE. • Beautiful, spacious interiors and clean restrooms. • Chelsea Market is definitely a must-visit when you’re in NYC! 💛

review1: Chelsea Market's small independent shops are a draw, with shoppers finding unusual items and gifts beyond the typical souvenir stores.
review2: The food halls are the main reason many visit, offering a wide variety of tasty dishes in a lively, welcoming atmosphere.
review3: Visitors admire the building itself, a handsome converted industrial space that makes wandering between restaurants and shops part of the fun.
review4: The artist and flea market area earns special mention for creative finds, adding a craft-market feel to a food-focused visit.
